interface.longDescription:
Check public reward terms without signing in. Sign in once by email to see saved rewards, unused codes and prices across linked stores. You can also sign in to one store or try the shared test account. The wallet does not make new codes from points. Checkout stays on the store.

Ask about a store by name and tell us your cart subtotal to see its public reward terms. Your wallet can save a private reward claim and show available rewards, expiry and unused codes from linked stores. Price comparisons estimate merchandise totals after saved rewards and exclude shipping, tax and other discounts. The shared test account uses illustrative data and its codes cannot be used at checkout.

name: stabilerewards-ai

positive.description: P1: Public terms by store name while signed out.
positive.prompt: What would a first $60 order earn at Stabile Agentic Commerce?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Stabile Agentic Commerce (ra3kpj-p3) without sign-in. Report the USD $60 minimum, 300-point first-order bonus and $10 future-order tier. Present terms as conditional.

positive.description: P2: Sign in with a review account, then save a claim. Use a review email, its passcode and one fresh private demo claim from Review details.
positive.prompt: Show my wallet so I can sign in. Then open REVIEW_CLAIM_LINK_01 privately and send its prefilled save prompt.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for sign-in first. On the Stabile page enter the review email, then enter its passcode in the code field; no email is needed. The wallet opens. After the shopper approves the claim, save a $10 demo reward and link Stabile Agentic Commerce. No points are spent.

positive.description: P3: List saved rewards, then explicitly request unused codes using the wallet from P2.
positive.prompt: What rewards are in my wallet? Show the management link. Then ask separately: Show my unused reward codes.
positive.expected_behavior: The first response shows the available $10 demo reward, expiry and private management link without code text. The second shows the existing unused code from the linked demo store and follows the returned restrictions. Nothing is issued or applied.

positive.description: P4: Compare prices, then check personal options at the linked store using the wallet from P2.
positive.prompt: Compare Stabile Agentic Commerce at $63.99 USD after saved rewards with an unnamed $60 alternative. Then check my personal reward options at Stabile Agentic Commerce for the $63.99 cart.
positive.expected_behavior: Estimate $53.99 after the $10 reward, $6.01 below the supplied alternative. Mark rewards at the unnamed alternative unknown and exclude shipping, tax and other discounts. Personal options show the $10 eligible value and one unused code without creating a code or spending points.

positive.description: P5: Connect another account and choose the shared test account. Run this separately from the email wallet.
positive.prompt: Check the shared test account's reward for an A$60 cart.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_authorized_reward_value with cart_total 60 after shared-test authorization. Require sample_account true, currency_code AUD, and discount_applied false. Describe the current tool result: if unused_code_count is 0, report no reward and no unused code (existing_code_values []); if unused_code_count is 1, report one existing illustrative A$10 code (existing_code_values [10]). eligible_reward_values is [] in both sample states: an existing code is not a second new reward. Never assume a reset, invent a code, or report zero after a lookup error. Identify the shared test account and state that test codes cannot work at checkout. Do not ask for a password, email, customer ID or points balance.

negative.description: N1: After P2–P5, use the wallet management link to delete the email account, confirm deletion, and sign in fresh before linking any store.
negative.prompt: Check my personal rewards at Stabile Agentic Commerce for a $60 cart.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the store is not linked and that the lookup does not establish a zero balance.

negative.description: N2: In the fresh wallet from N1, retry the same private claim saved in P2.
negative.prompt: Try to save the reward from the same private claim again.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse the save because another wallet already consumed the claim. No entry is added to the fresh wallet.

negative.description: N3: Ask before connecting a Stabile account, or right after deleting the account in N1 (ChatGPT then asks to reconnect).
negative.expected_behavior: Prompt for Stabile sign-in before returning personal wallet data.

review.commerce_description: Public program terms and a shopper reward wallet for linked Shopify stores. Shoppers can save claims and see existing rewards and codes. Checkout, payments and purchases stay on the store. The plugin does not issue codes or spend points.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.0.0 renames the plugin to Stabile Rewards Wallet. Email sign-in unlocks a wallet across linked stores, claim saving, unused codes and effective price estimates. Public terms, single-store sign-in and the shared test account are available. Checkout stays on the store.
